summary: feat(settings): send services in the fxaccounts:oauth_login message
description:
Because:

* Android needs the connected service without holding fxa_login state
* Desktop will read services from oauth_login so both clients match

This commit:

* Adds services to oauth_login wherever fxa_login sends it, sync as {}
* Keeps services in fxa_login and notes when it can be removed
* Documents the sync engine list history and CWTS moving into Firefox
* Removes the outdated "mobile should move to fxaLogin" comments
* Checks oauth_login services in the Relay functional tests

Closes FXA-14892
